data.description: RED task. Implement fetch_snapshot(pass_id) -> Path in plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/fetcher.py. Calls AcliClient.search_issues(), normalizes each issue into a key→fields dict, writes flat JSON to bridge_state/snapshots/<pass_id>.json with deterministic key ordering. Returns the written path. Two fetches over identical remote produce byte-identical snapshots (idempotency precondition for DD-3). Unit tests use stubbed AcliClient asserting file written, valid JSON, determinism, and error propagation.
data.title: Implement fetcher writing normalized snapshot to bridge_state/snapshots/<pass>.json
